_comment: choose —— 3 英文边界 / 4 现有中文义项。「作出选择」是「选择」的及物/不及物两面，不是独立义项（D24：同一含义不同及物性不构成拆分理由）。「欲」对应 choose.v.03 see fit or proper to act（愿意/决定要…）。
_mergeNote: 4 -> 3。① 选择+作出选择 合并为 s1（fromLines 给英文、fromZh 接住中文侧）。② 宁愿 对上 raw=1。③ 欲 对上 choose.v.03。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives。
对应英文 raw=1 select as an alternative over another —— choose A rather than B。
对应 choose.v.03 see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way —— 愿意/决定要。补缺层收进，ECDICT definition 侧漏导。
与「选择」同义，只是及物性不同（choose sth / choose to do）。按 D24，同义不同及物性不构成拆分理由，合并。

senses.note: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives。线索：choose between A and B / choose to do sth。
select as an alternative over another。线索：would choose A rather than B / choose to do rather than do。常见结构是 choose + 动词原形 + rather than。
see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way。补缺层收进，ECDICT definition 侧漏导。线索：They chose to remain silent.
